---
title: "Validated cross-tool comparisons"
engine: knitr
---

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("lidarbench_report.R")
lb_banner()
comparisons <- lb_table("comparisons")
```

A ratio is shown only when both tools' included measurements passed the
comparability gate: validated report mode, every attempt `comparable` under the
campaign's frozen comparability policy (`strict`: numerically validated, matched
definition, zero boundary differences; `edge-tolerant`: also declared
boundary-point differences and the explicit outward-extent exception, listed in
`accepted_differences`), the same
workload contract and digest, equivalence group, dataset digest, campaign
identity (same machine), timing boundary and run dimensions (CPUs, execution
mode). `speedup_a_vs_b` = time of *b* / time of *a* (how many times faster *a*
is), from medians and from means.

## Comparable pairs

```{r}
#| results: asis
ok <- comparisons[comparisons$comparable %in% TRUE, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(ok)) {
  cat("_No tool pair passed the comparability gate in this report._\n\n")
} else {
  lb_kable(ok, c("workload", "dataset", "cpus", "tool_a", "tool_b", "n_a", "n_b",
                 "median_a_seconds", "median_b_seconds", "speedup_a_vs_b_median",
                 "speedup_a_vs_b_mean", "comparability_policy", "accepted_differences"))
}
```

## Pairs that are not comparable

Listed so that missing comparisons are explained, not hidden. No ratio is
computed for these pairs.

```{r}
#| results: asis
lb_kable(comparisons[!(comparisons$comparable %in% TRUE), , drop = FALSE],
         c("workload", "dataset", "cpus", "tool_a", "tool_b", "evidence_a", "evidence_b",
           "reasons"))
lb_download("comparisons")
```
